messages:
Lucia: Quick sync — PRD updated with a headroom smoothing proposal for reserved pools. Need legal + ops to sign off on contract wording and on-call handoff. Excerpt:

Lucia: > Headroom carryover: up to 10% unused reserved capacity may be applied to the next billing period as temporary burst credits; consumption beyond reserved limits falls under burst billing.

Lucia: Can @Sam and @Tasha review? We need language and an ops flow for pilot customers by Tue.

Sam (Legal): Two quick asks: define 'billing period', clarify if carryover is transferable between tenants, and add a cap + expiry window. Draft suggestion: 'Carryover credits expire after 30 days and are non-transferable.' I'll post legal-friendly wording shortly.

Diego (Eng): From runtime: allowing carryover requires a credits ledger + idempotent issuance API and telemetry flags. Edge case: tenant migration and refunds. Rough estimate: 3 sprint days to add basic tracking + 2 days for tests.

Rohit (Customer Success): Customers want soft fallback when reserved capacity is exhausted -> auto-fallback to best-effort pool with notification. We should include an opt-in/opt-out clause for fallback behavior and a clear customer notice.

Nora (Sales): FYI enterprise buyers will push for higher carryover. Suggest tiers: standard 10% carryover, custom up to 30% by contract. Need clear SLA impact language so sales can negotiate.

Tasha (SRE): On-call proposal: automated fallback should only page on SLO breaches >5m; otherwise surface as console alert + support ticket. Add wording to contract that Redwood will only escalate to on-call per SLO thresholds.

Lucia: Ack. @Sam please paste final wording. @Diego ping ETA for pilot scope. I'll update PRD and block time for Tue sync 14:00.

Sam (Legal): Draft clause: 'Carryover credits (up to an agreed percentage of monthly reserved capacity) expire 30 days after issuance and are non-transferable. Usage beyond reserved capacity plus carryover will be billed at published burst rates. Redwood will notify customers of fallback events; escalation to support or on-call will occur only when latency or error-rate thresholds defined in the applicable SLO are breached.' Thoughts?

Diego (Eng): Implementation ETA for pilot: dev + unit/integration tests 8-10 business days, infra config and feature flagging 3 business days, telemetry + dashboard 4 days. We can shrink scope by limiting pilot to 5 tenants.

Lucia: Sounds good — locking to pilot + tiered contract options. Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll post final PRD update and add this to the roadmap doc.
